And this was approved by the CARES Act, if you will. And Miami-Dade County apparently received the funds and they're in charge of dispersing the funds throughout all the law enforcement agencies for their work during these unfortunate times.

Right now we have under CARES, we have this project approved. However, there's been some modification to the language. And based on that, our initial assessment was that the city was on the hook for $17,000 to be reimbursed by CARES. But because there was a change in the memorandum of understanding language between the PBA and all of the municipalities that are dealing with this, the amount has been reduced to $11,721 because it had to be only payable to those officers who were out there in the front lines and not for those sitting at home, either on sick leave, on COVID leave, or on any type of annual leave or comp time. You had to physically be out there on the road. So we went out and asked Major Delgado and the chief to go ahead and revisit the payrolls and he came up with a revised amount. So we would be on the hook for $11,721 and that is been approved by CARES. Now, do we have a check in hand? The answer is no.
